name: azure-databricks-genieone
title: Azure Databricks Genie One (beta)
summary: Access workspace-wide Azure Databricks Genie One through its legacy beta MCP endpoint, scheduled to retire on October 31, 2026.
description: Azure Databricks Genie One provides workspace-wide natural-language analytics through the legacy workspace MCP endpoint. Unlike the Genie Space connector, it does not require a Genie space ID. This beta endpoint is deprecated and scheduled to retire on October 31, 2026. It does not use Unity Gateway.
